compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is designed for creating and setting reminders for events. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Event Title Input**: A text field at the top where users can enter the name of the event (e.g., "Cool Event").
2. **Time and Date Selection**: Two buttons below the event title input for selecting the time (17:00) and date (3-31-2017) of the event.
3. **Background Image Selection**: An optional feature to select a background image for the event reminder, with a sample image displayed.
4. **Add Reminder Button**: A prominent button labeled "ADD REMINDER" to save the event reminder.
5. **Start Countdown Button**: A button at the bottom labeled "START COUNTDOWN" to initiate a countdown to the event.

Additionally, there is an advertisement banner at the top of the screen.
